rulesNotes: The standard-path course values are WGU competency units. Source semester credits, where published, remain separately attached to outside-course options.

Outside options come only from WGU's published partner agreements for BSHS catalog 202406 (program 167). Each cited agreement retains its own capture and review date. Pathophysiology must be taken within the past five years in order to receive transfer credit.

This evaluation is based upon current transfer policies and is not guaranteed in perpetuity. Please contact your Enrollment Counselor if your start date is more than 30 days from the date of this evaluation to determine if any updates to transfer policies have occurred that will change the results of your evaluation. Certification must be current or have been taken within the last 5 years to be considered for transfer. Please refer to the General Transfer Guidelines for more information. Competency units are based on semester units for transfer. Transfer courses may not be used to fulfill more than one course of study. Students must complete at least 25% of the required undergraduate degree competency units through residency requirements.

rulesNotes: The standard-path course values are WGU competency units. Source semester credits, where published, remain separately attached to outside-course options.

Outside options come only from WGU's published partner agreements for BSSWE catalog 202610 (program 254). Each cited agreement retains its own capture and review date. Approved courses without an independent provider identity, contradictory course labels, and awards needing several source courses together are held out of the plan.
General education is labeled only where WGU’s current program record names the area of study General Education. Remaining named courses stay in core requirements.

Certifications were not factored in for transfer but can be transferred if applicable, passed, and documented. All certifications and IT-specific courses must have been completed within the past five years to be considered for transfer. Verify each program's prerequisites and transferable IT Certifications by going to the General Transfer Guidelines . This evaluation is based upon current transfer policies and is not guaranteed in perpetuity. Please contact your Enrollment Counselor if your start date is more than 30 days from the date of this evaluation to determine if any updates to transfer policies have occurred that will change the results of your evaluation. Competency units are based on semester units for transfer. Transfer courses may not be used to fulfill more than one course of study. Students must complete at least 25% of the required undergraduate degree competency units through residency requirements.

The exact BSSWE 202610 required course set is reviewed against its current official catalog table and program receiving guidelines. No separately declared formal capstone occurs in this bounded course set; other editions do not inherit that finding. Any course marked non-transferable still stays at WGU.

models.title: Information Technology
rulesNotes: The standard-path course values are WGU competency units. Source semester credits, where published, remain separately attached to outside-course options.

Outside options come only from WGU's published partner agreements for BSIT catalog 202608 (program 250). Each cited agreement retains its own capture and review date. Approved courses without an independent provider identity, contradictory course labels, and awards needing several source courses together are held out of the plan.
General education is labeled only where WGU’s current program record names the area of study General Education. Remaining named courses stay in core requirements.

Certifications were not factored in for transfer but can be transferred if applicable, passed, and documented. All certifications and IT-specific courses must have been completed within the past five years to be considered for transfer. Verify each program's prerequisites and transferable IT Certifications by going to the General Transfer Guidelines . This evaluation is based upon current transfer policies and is not guaranteed in perpetuity. Please contact your Enrollment Counselor if your start date is more than 30 days from the date of this evaluation to determine if any updates to transfer policies have occurred that will change the results of your evaluation. Competency units are based on semester units for transfer. Transfer courses may not be used to fulfill more than one course of study. Students must complete at least 25% of the required undergraduate degree competency units through residency requirements.

The exact BSIT 202608 required course set is reviewed against its current official catalog table and program receiving guidelines. No separately declared formal capstone occurs in this bounded course set; other editions do not inherit that finding. Any course marked non-transferable still stays at WGU.

notes: Published tuition per six-month term. Confirm current mandatory fees, materials, financial-aid eligibility and the applicable program catalog. This is not a quoted total degree cost.

rulesNotes: The standard-path course values are WGU competency units. Source semester credits, where published, remain separately attached to outside-course options.

Outside options come only from WGU's published partner agreements for BSCSIA catalog 202610 (program 253). Each cited agreement retains its own capture and review date. This evaluation is based upon current transfer policies and is not guaranteed in perpetuity. Students must complete at least 25% of the required undergraduate degree competency units through residency requirements.

rulesNotes: The standard-path course values are WGU competency units. Source semester credits, where published, remain separately attached to outside-course options.

Outside options come only from WGU's published partner agreements for BSCS catalog 202611 (program 261). Each cited agreement retains its own capture and review date. Approved courses without an independent provider identity, contradictory course labels, and awards needing several source courses together are held out of the plan.
General education is labeled only where WGU’s current program record names the area of study General Education. Remaining named courses stay in core requirements.
A course in Calculus I or higher must be taken within the past 5 years.

Certifications were not factored in for transfer but can be transferred if applicable, passed, and documented. All certifications and IT-specific courses must have been completed within the past five years to be considered for transfer. Verify each program's prerequisites and transferable IT Certifications by going to the General Transfer Guidelines . This evaluation is based upon current transfer policies and is not guaranteed in perpetuity. Please contact your Enrollment Counselor if your start date is more than 30 days from the date of this evaluation to determine if any updates to transfer policies have occurred that will change the results of your evaluation. Competency units are based on semester units for transfer. Transfer courses may not be used to fulfill more than one course of study. Students must complete at least 25% of the required undergraduate degree competency units through residency requirements.

rulesNotes: The standard-path course values are WGU competency units. Source semester credits, where published, remain separately attached to outside-course options.

Outside options come only from WGU's published partner agreements for BSCNE catalog 202608 (program 246). Each cited agreement retains its own capture and review date. Approved courses without an independent provider identity, contradictory course labels, and awards needing several source courses together are held out of the plan.
General education is labeled only where WGU’s current program record names the area of study General Education. Remaining named courses stay in core requirements.
The plan includes only reviewed exact-program receiving matches. University courses without an outside option are not proof that no transfer exists; additional approved provider matches may exist.

Certifications were not factored in for transfer but can be transferred if applicable, passed, and documented. All certifications and IT-specific courses must have been completed within the past five years to be considered for transfer. Verify each program's prerequisites and transferable IT Certifications by going to the General Transfer Guidelines . This evaluation is based upon current transfer policies and is not guaranteed in perpetuity. Please contact your Enrollment Counselor if your start date is more than 30 days from the date of this evaluation to determine if any updates to transfer policies have occurred that will change the results of your evaluation. Competency units are based on semester units for transfer. Transfer courses may not be used to fulfill more than one course of study. Students must complete at least 25% of the required undergraduate degree competency units through residency requirements.

notes: The official family page separately lists all four named tracks at the same published tuition. The term basket includes the mandatory resource fee; provider charges and other applicable fees remain separate. No complete degree-price or finish-time quote is asserted.

rulesNotes: The standard-path course values are WGU competency units. Source semester credits, where published, remain separately attached to outside-course options.

Outside options come only from WGU's published partner agreements for BSCNEAWS catalog 202608 (program 247). Each cited agreement retains its own capture and review date. Approved courses without an independent provider identity, contradictory course labels, and awards needing several source courses together are held out of the plan.
General education is labeled only where WGU’s current program record names the area of study General Education. Remaining named courses stay in core requirements.
The plan includes only reviewed exact-program receiving matches. University courses without an outside option are not proof that no transfer exists; additional approved provider matches may exist.

Certifications were not factored in for transfer but can be transferred if applicable, passed, and documented. All certifications and IT-specific courses must have been completed within the past five years to be considered for transfer. Verify each program's prerequisites and transferable IT Certifications by going to the General Transfer Guidelines . This evaluation is based upon current transfer policies and is not guaranteed in perpetuity. Please contact your Enrollment Counselor if your start date is more than 30 days from the date of this evaluation to determine if any updates to transfer policies have occurred that will change the results of your evaluation. Competency units are based on semester units for transfer. Transfer courses may not be used to fulfill more than one course of study. Students must complete at least 25% of the required undergraduate degree competency units through residency requirements.

notes: The official family page separately lists all four named tracks at the same published tuition. The term basket includes the mandatory resource fee; provider charges and other applicable fees remain separate. No complete degree-price or finish-time quote is asserted.

externalMaxCredits.note: Overall university ceiling. Exact receiving-course approval and required WGU coursework may allow fewer outside CUs.

alternativeMaxCredits.note: Alternative credit shares the overall ceiling; this is not approval of any provider or outside course.

rulesNotes: The standard-path course values are WGU competency units. Source semester credits, where published, remain separately attached to outside-course options.

Approved courses without an independent provider identity, contradictory course labels, and awards needing several source courses together are held out of the plan.
General education is labeled only where WGU’s current program record names the area of study General Education. Remaining named courses stay in core requirements.
The plan includes only reviewed exact-program receiving matches. University courses without an outside option are not proof that no transfer exists; additional approved provider matches may exist.

Certifications were not factored in for transfer but can be transferred if applicable, passed, and documented. All certifications and IT-specific courses must have been completed within the past five years to be considered for transfer. Verify each program's prerequisites and transferable IT Certifications by going to the General Transfer Guidelines . This evaluation is based upon current transfer policies and is not guaranteed in perpetuity. Please contact your Enrollment Counselor if your start date is more than 30 days from the date of this evaluation to determine if any updates to transfer policies have occurred that will change the results of your evaluation. Competency units are based on semester units for transfer. Transfer courses may not be used to fulfill more than one course of study. Students must complete at least 25% of the required undergraduate degree competency units through residency requirements.

institutionMinCredits.basis: Conservative policy-derived minimum: 50% of active graduate degree CUs in addition to the named four-CU required capstone. The numeric result is calculated from the two policy clauses and program ledger; it is not a university-printed program minimum.

externalMaxCredits.note: Necessary ceiling implied by the graduate residency fraction, not a claim that any outside course is accepted. Additional capstone residency is enforced separately.

conservativeSufficientCondition.derivation: 50% of required graduate degree CUs earned directly in the active program in addition to required capstone CUs.

residencyPolicy.capstoneEvidence: C218 is explicitly named as this program's capstone in the current institutional ledger and capstone course description.

policyReview.message: The complete named graduate CU ledger is enforced directly; no undergraduate upper-division credit rule is imported.

notes: Published tuition and mandatory resources per six-month term. Actual term count and other applicable personal charges are separate; the older one-year promotional amount is not used.

admissionRequirements.message: Submit official transcripts establishing a bachelor's degree from a recognized, accredited institution. The program does not require the GRE or GMAT.

pacePolicy.basis: Fully online competency-based progress; work through courses as mastery is demonstrated with the assigned program mentor. No fixed completion duration is promised.

rulesNotes: All 35 planned CUs are taken in the active WGU graduate program. No undergraduate ACE, alternative-provider or outside graduate-course award is proposed.
The applicable program catalog 201408 and all eleven course codes are printed in the current November 2026 institutional catalog; the program catalog is not relabeled as 202611.
Graduate transfer eligibility varies by program. The residency ceiling is a necessary academic constraint and does not establish a particular incoming award.
The printed standard-path terms describe WGU's standard plan, not a guaranteed completion schedule or a formal prerequisite matrix.

unresolved.message: Submit the graduate application and official bachelor's transcripts and meet WGU's individual admission requirements.
